player_prompt.intro: Welcome to Lights Out! Waxaad leedahay {size}x{size} shabag ah oo nalalka. Your goolku waa in ay soo jeedin ALL nalalka OFF (wakiil by '.') Marka aad riixdo iftiin, waxa ay isku beddelato laftiisa iyo deriska ah (kor / hoos / bidix / midig). nooca [row col] in ay ku riixdo iftiin (0-indexed, sidaas kala duwan oo sax ah waa 0-{max_index}). Waxaad leedahay ilaa {max_turns} dhaqaaqdo si ay u xaliyaan xujo ah. Legend: 'O' = iftiin ON, '.' = iftiin OFF

board.current_state: Xaaladda shabakadda hadda jirta (Guurista {moves_made}, {moves_left} guuro harsan, {completion}% dhammaystiran): {grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Waxqabadka waa in uu ahaadaa qaabka [row col] halka safka iyo safka ay yihiin tirooyin dhan laga bilaabo 0 ilaa {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Koordineetada waa inay noqdaan u dhexeeya 0 iyo {max_index}. Waxaad galisay [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Gacanta ku guulaysa! Waxaad xalliyeysay puzzle-ka {moves_used} ku guulaysto!
outcome.loss: Ciyaarta dhamaatay! Waxaad isticmaashay dhammaan {max_turns} dhaqaaqyada adigoon xallin halxiraalaha. Dhammaystirka kama dambaysta ah: {completion}% Xaaladda kama dambaysta ah: {grid}
